Under CH, such a space (for Problem 3 in [Ar2013]) exists as
constructed in [Ya1976] by Yakovlev.
references: [Ar2013] Arhangeliski, Alexandr. "Selected old open problems in general topology." Buletinul Academiei de Ştiinţe a Republicii Moldova. Matematica 73.2-3 (2013): 37-46. https://www.math.md/files/basm/y2013-n2-3/y2013-n2-3-(pp37-46).pdf.pdf

[Ya1976] Yakovlev, N. N. "On the theory of o-metrizable spaces." Doklady Akademii Nauk. Vol. 229. No. 6. Russian Academy of Sciences, 1976. https://www.mathnet.ru/links/016f74007f9f96fa3aadae05cbd98457/dan40570.pdf (in Russian)
